note: The game reads this file when it opens. To publish a new build: put it on main as labs/pindutan-v21.html, then bump build here to the same tag. Every copy — hosted or on a phone — updates itself from it. The runner reads the same file: menu names the deck (the three-game menu), so pindutan-run.html always opens the newest one. Set "ladder" to a full https address to move the leaderboard to a host of its own; leave it empty to keep api-leaderboard.php on aidekupal.unaux.com.
